Definition: a smiter, i.e. a war club
BiblicalUsage: mappêts is a smiter, a war club or battle axe, and it occurs once, in Jeremiah 51:20. There God calls His servant His battle axe and weapons of war, and says with him He will break in pieces the nations and destroy kingdoms. The word is a person used as God's weapon.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe mappêts shows me that God can make a man His battle axe, and I hold that being His weapon is better than being His target.
